macros.name: DefineFNsymbols
macros.doc: The macro \DefineFNsymbols allows the user to define a set of footnote symbols, to be used with the \setfnsymbol command.

macros.name: footnotemargin
macros.doc: If \footnotemargin is a positive length, the footnote mark will be set with its right edge \footnotemargin from the margin.

macros.name: hangfootparindent
macros.doc: The footnote itself may of course be longer than one paragraph; if so, the paragraphs will be separated by the vertical space specified by \hangfootparskip, and the second and subsequent paragraphs are indented by \hangfootparindent.

macros.name: hangfootparskip
macros.doc: The footnote itself may of course be longer than one paragraph; if so, the paragraphs will be separated by the vertical space specified by \hangfootparskip, and the second and subsequent paragraphs are indented by \hangfootparindent.

macros.name: pagefootnoterule
macros.doc: By default, \mpfootnoterule and \pagefootnoterule retain the original definition of \footnoterule (which may have been modified by a norule option), while \splitfootnoterule becomes a full-width rule.

macros.name: splitfootnoterule
macros.doc: By default, \mpfootnoterule and \pagefootnoterule retain the original definition of \footnoterule (which may have been modified by a norule option), while \splitfootnoterule becomes a full-width rule.
